$comment: Per-component versions for the lead-magnet document surface. The plugin version tells someone the PLUGIN is
stale; this tells them which of the components THEY used actually changed, which is the only
thing that makes them act. Bump a component's version in the same commit that changes its spec
— scripts/check-drift.sh reads this file and a build's stamp, and reports the intersection.
version = the plugin version in which that component's spec last changed.
breaking = true when a build using it will render WRONG until updated, as opposed to merely
missing an improvement. It is the difference between a red notice and an amber one.
Seeded by deriving, for each spec doc, the first release that shipped its last change — not
by stamping everything at the current version, which would have told every existing build that
all of its components moved at once.
